name: Lattice Semiconductor
outlook:
What Lattice Semiconductor says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueLattice revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be between $325 million and $345 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: gross marginLattice gross margin for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be 72.0% plus or minus 1% on a non-GAAP basis.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: operating expensesTotal operating expenses for the fourth quarter of 2026 are expected to be between $95 million and $101 million on a non-GAAP basis.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: net income per shareNet income for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be between $0.82 and $0.86 per share on a non-GAAP basis.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
